BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E27 The Space Museum: The Dimensions of Time Back on the proper time track, the travellers take steps to change the future. A rebel force of native Xerons are plotting against the invading Moroks who have captured the Doctor.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E29 The Space Museum: The Final Phase After forcing Lobos to revive the Doctor, Ian is also taken prisoner. The Xeron rebellion is underway whilst the fate of the Doctor and his friends still hangs in the balance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S2 E28 The Space Museum: The Search As events escalate, the travellers fear that they will not be able to escape their fate. Vicki helps orchestrate a raid on the Moroks’ armoury. Ian attempts to rescue the Doctor.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Kangaroo Island
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Sneak Attack
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Give yourself a nutritional sneak attack with Mary's recipes that cram in the good stuff without skimping on flavour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia - Heritage
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Heritage visits Rumah Putih, experiences Rumah Makan Rendang Tok Yeop and cooks Pucuk Paku Masak Cili Api and Dendeng Daging.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express - Razzle Dazzle
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's party time at Nigella's and this is one party that's full of fast, easy, delicious make in advance recipes and simple, achievable, last minute touches to make the food table and the party itself.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy - Piedmont
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Stanley Tucci visits the region that made the dream of unified Italy a reality. Piedmont boasts refined French heritage of the Middle Ages, and is now spearheading a slow food revolution.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize - Ishikawa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: In his wife's hometown, Adam Liaw uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie's Comfort Food - Curried Fish Pie, Butter And Sage Gnudi And Hummingbird Cake
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Episode five sees Jamie and young son, Buddy, making a curried fish pie. Unlike a traditional fish pie, this Indian-inspired version has amazing perfumed layers of flavour and a crispy top.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Poh & Co. Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The delicious world of acclaimed cook, artist and lover of life Poh Ling Yeow, with a guide to some of her favourite dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Food Culture
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Venison
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: In this episode of Wild Game Kitchen, Andrew Zimmern demonstrates two distinct approaches to cooking venison.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - One Dish, Two Meals
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Weeknight dinners just got easier by Lidia simply serving one recipe two ways! Lidia prepares a zucchini, peas, and pancetta risotto, risotto cakes, and talks about capellini asparagus frittatas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - Haloumi: Cyprus
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Squeaky, salty haloumi is one of the world's best-loved grilled cheeses. However most of it is now mass produced using cows milk. Will heads to the island of Cyprus to see how it's traditionally made.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Flavour Pioneers
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buddy visits two culinary powerhouses who are bringing the flavours of their native countries to the places they now call home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy - Pasta: The Stuff Of Life
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Sydvestjylland, Denmark
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Tareq starts the next leg of his journey by visiting Sydvestjylland-a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero - Moa And More
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Nornie ventures to the picturesque Moa Island, where she meets with Hans Awang. Together, they explore his lush garden brimming with fresh produce and the bountiful ocean at his doorstep.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Kangaroo Island
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline.

bbc3.uk.title: Horrible Histories
bbc3.uk.description: There is public confusion when King Charles II bans coffee shops and a seasick chicken ruins a Roman sea battle. Later, mighty Egyptian Pharaoh, Ramesses II, meets some smelly peasants on Historical Wife Swap, and a cave-dwelling Stone Age couple try to buy their first house.

bbc3.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
bbc3.uk.description: The Smith family embark upon a mammoth declutter. Stacey and the team challenge them to let go of half of their possessions, so that they can beautifully reorganise their life and home. Two years ago, Raaj, her husband Roydel and their toddler son, Ajay, moved in with their two nieces, Simran and Harjoth, and nephew Gurkeerat when their mum (Raaj's sister) passed away after contracting Covid.

bbc3.uk.title: The Traitors Ireland
bbc3.uk.description: Siobhán McSweeney charges into chaos, suspicion, and stylish skulduggery. A group of strangers arrives at the castle. Their mission is to win ?50,000 without getting murdered or banished in the game. The twist? The Traitors walk amongst them.

bbc3.uk.title: God's Creatures (2022)
bbc3.uk.description: A mother tells a lie for her beloved son that rips apart their family and close-knit Irish town -- ultimately testing her own sense of right and wrong.

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Death in the Barracks
bbc3.uk.description: In 2021, 19-year-old soldier Jaysley Beck was found dead in her army barracks. Through unprecedented access to her family, friends and former colleagues, Stacey Dooley traces her journey from excited young recruit to victim of sexual assault. As her family seeks answers and fights for change, the film explores the experiences of women in the armed forces and asks what more can be done to protect them. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Stacey Dooley - Fallen Women
bbc3.uk.description: Stacey Dooley looks into the deaths of women who have fallen from heights, interrogating how these deaths are investigated and exploring whether domestic abuse played a part. (Documentary, Public affairs) - 2026

bbc3.uk.title: Jobfished
bbc3.uk.description: It's 2020. Covid Britain is in lockdown and the world is working from home. In the depths of the deadly pandemic and when people are at their lowest, someone spots an opportunity. This is the insane story of how people from all over the world were hired to work for a seemingly glamorous and successful design agency, but the whole thing was fake. (Documentary, Special) - 2022

bbc3.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out
bbc3.uk.description: The Smith family embark upon a mammoth declutter. (Home improvement, House/garden, Reality) - 2023

bbc4.uk.title: This Is BBC Four

bbc4.uk.title: This Is BBC Four
bbc4.uk.description: BBC FOUR is the BBC channel for people who want more. More depth, more range, more to stimulate the mind.

bbc4.uk.title: Earth's Natural Wonders - Surviving Against the Odds
bbc4.uk.description: In some natural wonders people push themselves to the limit to survive. For the people who call these extraordinary places home, survival requires skill, Ingenuity and bravery. These places include Brazil, Ethiopia, Laos, and Switzerland.

bbc4.uk.title: The Lost Neanderthals
bbc4.uk.description: The Mandrin Cave in southern France has been attracting the attention of archaeologists for 30 years. The cave was regularly occupied in prehistoric times, and a remarkable record of human habitation has been preserved by its soils.

bbc4.uk.title: Natural World - Shorts: Jungle Animal Hospital
bbc4.uk.description: At the jungle animal hospital in Guatemala, the wards are full of exotic patients, many of them orphans rescued from the illegal pet trade.

bbc4.uk.title: Arena - Dickens on Film
bbc4.uk.description: From the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high definition television, this documentary revisits films and interviews from the archive to answer the question of why Dickens's novels have inspired so many hundreds of adaptations on screen.

bbc4.uk.title: Remembers.. - Sandy Welch Remembers... Our Mutual Friend
bbc4.uk.description: Acclaimed screenwriter Sandy Welch looks back on her adaptation of Charles Dickens's final novel, Our Mutual Friend, as she recounts the challenges in bringing this multilayered gothic story to life. The 1998 drama featured a slew of renowned actors, including Anna Friel, Keeley Hawes, Paul McGann and David Morrissey, and drew praise from critics at the time for its dark, gritty storytelling, winning Sandy a BAFTA for Best Drama Serial of the year.

bbc4.uk.title: Our Mutual Friend
bbc4.uk.description: The Boffins inherit a fortune when John Harmon, the only son and heir of their old employer, apparently drowns. Bella Wilfer, his wife-to-be by terms of old Harmon's will, goes into mourning though she has never met her fiancé. The Boffins hire a very capable but mysterious young man as secretary, John Rokesmith, whose keen interest in Bella holds the secret to his true identity.

bbc4.uk.title: Our Mutual Friend
bbc4.uk.description: Lizzie Hexam is courted by Eugene Wrayburn, a dissolute barrister, and Bradley Headstone, a mentally-deranged schoolmaster.

bbc4.uk.title: Scrooge with Bransby Williams
bbc4.uk.description: Bransby Williams plays the part of Scrooge in a reading of Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol. First broadcast in 1952 and considered the BBC's first televised Dickens adaptation.

bbc4.uk.title: Scrooge with Bransby Williams
bbc4.uk.description: Bransby Williams plays the part of Scrooge in a reading of Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol. First broadcast in 1952 and considered the BBC's first televised Dickens adaptation.

bbc4.uk.title: Earth's Natural Wonders - Surviving with Animals

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Eggs and Cheese Chef Raymond Blanc combines the universally popular ingredients of egg and cheese to make a classic omelette with a secret technique; he then uses a Comte from his home region in France to make a family-style souffle.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

bbconelondon.uk.description: Firefighters and farmers tackle Bedfordshire field fires, rescue crews respond to a horse in danger, and Paul Colgan helps volunteers protect wildlife from illegal badger baiters. (Documentary, Agriculture) - 2025

bbconelondon.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbconelondon.uk.description: A flat in Clapham, a terrace in Kent and a bungalow in Stoke-on-Trent are all sold under the hammer. Jacqui, Martin and Dion meet the successful bidders, including a mother and daughter taking on their first family development and a part-time property developer who spends more than five times his original budget. (Documentary, Home improvement, House/garden) - 2023

bbconelondon.uk.title: Bargain Hunt - Ardingly 19
bbconelondon.uk.description: Tim Wonnacott and his trusty team of experts head south to the Ardingly Antiques Fair. Charlie and Charles assist the reds and blues, Tim comes across a rather moving picture frame, and everyone gets a little excited down at the auction. (Arts/crafts, Auction, Collectibles, Game show) - 2015

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bargain Hunt
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S69 E19 Wetherby 19 Doctors and married couple Gareth and Linda compete against retailers Natalie and Steph at an antiques fair in Wetherby, West Yorkshire, with advice from experts Philip Serrell and Jonathan Pratt. Caroline Hawley keeps an eye on proceedings and also heads across to Leeds to admire a collection of miniature hats created by 19th-century hatter John Craig.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E42 Cornwall Jules Hudson meets a couple who have spent a few decades in Australia, but have decided to swap the surf and sunshine for the lovely views and charm of Cornwall. He also visits an abandoned slate quarry that has been transformed into an extraordinary off-grid retreat, full of creativity and coastal magic.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Glasgow - A Fix at the Top of the Cathedral Dominic Chinea and Lucia Scalisi help repair Glasgow Cathedral's weathervane at the top of the 225ft spire, save a Chinese unicorn mask made of bamboo and paper that plays and important part in celebrations for Glasgow's Hakka Chinese Community, and discover how street art is changing the city.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E23 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Philippa, Nathan, Pete, Natalie and Sandra race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S31 E2 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E5 The penultimate leg through Australia sees a decisive Jeff and Matt risk an inland route to save funds for the final push, only to find themselves stranded in a remote town with no obvious connections. Princess and Junior choose to travel down the coast, but with their budget critically low they need to work as much as possible to make it to the final stage. Ella and Nana head to the shores of the largest sand island in the world, where Ella reflects on her recent heartbreak, and Sam and Kaz make a blunder that causes them precious time.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E11 Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by South African chef Ash Valenzuela-Heeger, winner of the 2025 Michelin Young Chef Award, who sets the contestants the challenge of making barbecue beef sirloin, served with maitake mushrooms, caramelised roscoff onions and a cafe au lait sauce. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge as they serve up dessert.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MOTD: UEFA Champions League : 25/11/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Action from the matchday five fixtures, including Club Brugge v Liverpool at Jan Breydel Stadium, Sporting Lisbon v Manchester United at Estádio José Alvalade and Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium. Liverpool were looking to bounce back from a shock defeat at the hands of Fenerbahce in matchday four, while United will have wanted to build on a comeback against AS Roma, and Arsenal aimed to maintain their unbeaten record in this season's competition.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

cinemax.us.title: It
cinemax.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun.

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love.

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (movie) - 2024

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast.

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Man Down
cinemaxaction.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Open Water
cinemaxaction.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Nerve
cinemaxaction.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shot Caller
cinemaxaction.us.description: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

cinemaxaction.us.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
cinemaxaction.us.description: New York City cop John McClane (Bruce Willis) arrives in Moscow to track down his estranged son, Jack (Jai Courtney). McClane thinks his son is a criminal, so it comes as a shock when he learns that Jack is actually working undercover to protect Komarov (Sebastian Koch), a Russian government whistleblower. With their own lives on the line, McClane and Jack must overcome their differences in order to get Komarov to safety and thwart a potentially disastrous crime in the Chernobyl region.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Odd Jobs
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The summer job situation looks bleak for five college pals until they decide to start their own moving business.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Repo Men
cinemaxclassics.us.description: In the future, medical technology has advanced to the point where people can buy artificial organs to extend their lives. But if they default on payments, an organization known as the Union sends agents to repossess the organs. Remy (Jude Law) is one of the best agents in the business, but when he becomes the recipient of an artificial heart, he finds himself in the same dire straits as his many victims. With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger).

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxclassics.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman).

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxclassics.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemaxclassics.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

cinemaxclassics.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (movie) - 2005

cinemaxclassics.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxclassics.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (movie) - 2011

cinemaxhits.us.title: Colette
cinemaxhits.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century.

cinemaxhits.us.title: DC League of Super-Pets
cinemaxhits.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemaxhits.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxhits.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
cinemaxhits.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.

cinemaxhits.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxhits.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Friendship
cinemaxhits.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Companion
cinemaxhits.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxhits.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies.

cinemaxhits.us.title: Black Adam
cinemaxhits.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (movie) - 2022

cinemaxwest.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxwest.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemaxwest.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

cinemaxwest.us.title: Wonka
cinemaxwest.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

cinemaxwest.us.title: Hoot
cinemaxwest.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Sessions
cinemaxwest.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (movie) - 2012

cinemaxwest.us.title: It
cinemaxwest.us.description: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown. (movie) - 1990

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun
cinemaxwest.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (movie) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: The Nun II
cinemaxwest.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (movie) - 2023

cinemaxwest.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemaxwest.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (movie) - 1996

cinesony.us.title: Moon
cinesony.us.description: El astronauta Sam Bell vive aislado durante tres años en una excavación minera lunar. Poco antes de que llegue el reemplazo, mientras sufre dolores de cabeza y alucinaciones, Sam descubre la presencia de una versión más joven de sí mismo.

cinesony.us.title: Cold Comes the Night
cinesony.us.description: Un criminal que está sufriendo una rápida pérdida de visión decide raptar a la propietaria de un hotel y a su joven hija. Las necesita para que sean sus ojos y poder recuperar un maletín de dinero que está en manos de un peligroso policía corrupto.

cinesony.us.title: The Contractor
cinesony.us.description: Un antiguo agente de la CIA es persuadido para volver al servicio y asesinar a un terrorista en Londres. Desgraciadamente, le tienden una trampa y le acusan de asesinato, obligándole a darse a la fuga.

cinesony.us.title: Felon
cinesony.us.description: Un hombre condenado por asesinato podría pasar el resto de su vida en prisión.

cinesony.us.title: A Few Good Men
cinesony.us.description: Dos jóvenes marinos son acusados de asesinar a un compañero. La defensa es otorgada al teniente Kaffee, más interesado en el béisbol que en derecho, y a la diligente teniente Galloway, quien llegará para cambiar rotundamente la visión del asesinato.

cinesony.us.title: Home Invasion
cinesony.us.description: Un especialista en sistemas de seguridad trata de ayudar a una mujer y su hijastro, cuando quedan a merced de tres expertos ladrones que se meten en su lujosa mansión en las afueras de la ciudad.

cinesony.us.title: The Myth of Fingerprints
cinesony.us.description: El extraño comportamiento del patriarca conduce a un descenso en el funcionamiento de una familia de Nueva Inglaterra.

cinesony.us.title: It Could Happen to You
cinesony.us.description: Un policía enfrenta a su codiciosa esposa cuando cumple su palabra de compartir el premio de la lotería con una mesera.

cinevault.us.title: The Waterdance
cinevault.us.description: Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives.

cinevault.us.title: Finding Graceland
cinevault.us.description: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

cinevault.us.title: Nothing in Common
cinevault.us.description: A successful advertising executive, David Basner, is working on a project that could make him partner at his company. When his parents suddenly end their 36-year marriage, he is thrown into the role of caregiver, dealing with his delicate mother, Lorraine, and his combative father, Max, who provides constant aggravation and bitter remarks. When one of his parents gets sick, David must choose what is more important, his family or his career.

cinevault.us.title: Running With Scissors
cinevault.us.description: As the son of an alcoholic father and a mentally ill mother, young Augusten Burroughs faces a challenging childhood at the very least. His life takes an unexpected turn when his mother gives him to her unorthodox therapist, and the boy becomes a member of the doctor's own strange, extended family.

cinevault.us.title: Relative Chaos
cinevault.us.description: Encouraged by his girlfriend (Charisma Carpenter), a man (Christopher Gorham) joins his two siblings for their father's (Terry Bradshaw) weeklong event of competitive games.

cinevault.us.title: The Green Hornet
cinevault.us.description: Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

cinevault.us.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind: The Director's Cut
cinevault.us.description: Science fiction adventure about a group of people who attempt to contact alien intelligence. Roy Neary (Richard Dreyfuss) witnesses an unidentified flying object, and even has a "sunburn" from its bright lights to prove it. Roy refuses to accept an explanation for what he saw and is prepared to give up his life to pursue the truth about UFOs.

circlecountry.us.description: Uncle Joe spreads a rumor of a silver strike has been found in the area as a scheme to get more people to stay at the Shady Rest, and dig his drainage ditch for free.

circlecountry.us.description: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

circlecountry.us.description: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

circlecountry.us.description: Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

circlecountry.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Aunt Bee's Medicine Man
circlecountry.us.description: Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

circlecountry.us.title: Rio Diablo
circlecountry.us.description: Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

circlecountry.us.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
circlecountry.us.description: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

circlecountry.us.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Duke Becomes a Father
circlecountry.us.description: Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten.

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051
classica.us.description: Václav Luks dirigiert das Collegium 1704 in Johann Sebastian Bachs Brandenburgische Konzerte 1-6. Im Jubiläumsjahr 2021 wurden sie im neu restaurierten Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses mit dem Collegium 1704 aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt.

classica.us.title: Galaxmphony - Die finale Odyssee
classica.us.description: Das DR Symphonieorchester sprengt die Schallmauer und entführt Sie in ferne Galaxien - an einen Ort, der zwischen Realität und Fantasie liegt, mit Soundtracks von Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune und vielen anderen.

classica.us.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt eine Aufführung von Schumanns "Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26".

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur, op. 36
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 2. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in D-Dur Op. 36, welche zum ersten Mal am 3. April 1803 aufgeführt wurde. Gezeigt wird eine Aufnahme aus dem Jahr 2014.

classica.us.title: Luisi dirigiert Mahler und Beethoven
classica.us.description: Die Sendung zeigt ein Konzert geleitet von Fabio Luisi mit der Musik von Mahler und Beethoven.

classica.us.title: Grieg - Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Dirigent Jan Latham-Koenig leitet das Flanders Symphony Orchestra mit einer Aufführung von Edvard Griegs Klavierkonzert in a-Moll, Op. 16. Diese Aufführung wurde am 21. April 2016 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe.

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Double Date
cleotv.us.description: Moesha (Brandy Norwood) and her ex-boyfriend (Fredro Starr) decide it's time for them to get over each other.

cleotv.us.title: Moesha - Talk of the Town

cleotv.us.title: One on One - Take This Job and Love It
cleotv.us.description: Breanna lands a job but fails to make a good impression on her boss (David Shatraw).

cleotv.us.title: Half & Half - The Big Training Day Episode

cmt.us.description: D.J. must perform a drama about the story of Thanksgiving at his school; when the play is a little patriotic, many parents are horrified, but the Connors are enthusiastic and celebrate the feast in their own way.

comet.us.title: The Librarians - And the Steal of Fortune
comet.us.description: When people begin getting hurt in the unluckiest of ways, the Librarians follow the trail to a casino where the owner appears to possess an artifact capable of stealing people's luck.

comet.us.title: The Librarians - And the Christmas Thief
comet.us.description: Santa takes Flynn, Baird and Jenkins on his first vacation in centuries; the Librarians use Santa's sleigh to save Ezekiel's career-criminal mother, as well as Christmas itself, from Santa's grinch of a brother, the Patron Saint of Thieves.

comet.us.title: Grimm - Death Do Us Part
comet.us.description: Rosalee and Monroe finally go on their honeymoon; Nick and Hank investigate a shocking homicide at an abandoned -- and supposedly haunted -- residence; Renard seeks help from a mystical woman.

comet.us.title: Grimm - Marechaussee
comet.us.description: A series of murders leads Nick and Hank to a mysterious bounty hunter and the Wesen council; Juliette receives disturbing news during a meeting with Henrietta.

comet.us.title: The Dark Crystal
comet.us.description: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

comet.us.title: Grimm - Trial by Fire
comet.us.description: An arson case forces Nick to ask an old foe for help; Viktor educates Adalind about well-played diplomacy; Juliette is involved in a confrontation.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Roast Chicken with Mushroom Orzo
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes herbed roast chicken breasts, paired with mushroom orzo and garlicky Swiss chard.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Simple School Night Supper
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia orders groceries from Hungryroot and makes sautéed chicken, rice, broccoli, and a pumpkin snack cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Sufganiyot (Hanukkah jelly doughnuts); the importance of schmaltz in Jewish cuisine; leave-in temperature probes; cast iron potato kugel.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - A Bold Brunch
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Brunch burgers; browned butter chocolate chunk muffins; a review of cooking sprays.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Mediterranean Feast
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: A whole roasted branzino; rice salad; slow cooker tomatoes; asparagus; a rustic walnut tart.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Classic French Cookies
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia bakes up four types of buttery French cookies: lemon sables, palmiers, florentines and pistachio financiers.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Lentil Soup and Anadama Bread
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes lentil soup with homemade Mexican-style chorizo, Anadama bread and a chocolate-stout Bundt cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - A Love Letter to the South
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Pan-fried pork chops with milk gravy; disposable utensils; jarred peppers; the origins of pimento cheese; creamy pimento mac and cheese.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Fried Chicken and Biscuits
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Lard-fried chicken; a tasting of regional potato chips; BLT salad; blueberry biscuits.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Biscuits and Chicken
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Butter and lard biscuits; the debate between lard and shortening; the benefits of full-sized and mini food processors; mimosa fried chicken.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Warm Supper for Cold Weather
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Beef borscht with homemade beef broth; rye bread topped with an olive oil marinated feta.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Holiday Cookies
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes anise cookies, chocolate crinkle cookies, wreath cookies, gingerbread cookies and chocolate bark.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Modern Suppers
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia shows us how to make lemony chicken, salmon rice bowls, Italian sausages, and lamb meatballs with orzo.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Thanksgiving, Simplified
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: One-pan turkey breast and stuffing; dressing vs. stuffing debate; buying turkey; pear-cranberry chutney; roasted butternut squash and apple.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Chicken and Biscuits
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Features one-batch fried chicken; strawberry spreads; North Carolina cheese biscuits.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Paprikash and Stroganoff
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Chicken paprikash and butter spaetzle; Hungarian immigrants in Cleveland; wooden spoons; ground beef stroganoff.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Spring Feast
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted fresh ham; inexpensive stand mixers; St. Louis gooey butter cake bars.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Sunday Brunch
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia whips up her favorite Bloody Marys with fresh horseradish and homemade cocktail onions plus sheet-pan hash browns for a crowd and springy green Shakshuka.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cool Food for Hot Weather
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia beats the heat with a light and summery gazpacho, seasoned croutons, a Spanish-inspired meat and cheese board and a fruity summer sangria for the crowd.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cast Iron Roast Beef
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes roast beef weeknight-friendly with her cast-iron roast beef with gravy, salt-crusted fingerling potatoes and carrot-noodle salad with homemade harissa and honey.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Elevated Friendsgiving Mains
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted duck with blackberry sauce; the best uses for different tinned fish; a rich bean bourguignon.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Short Ribs and Baked Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted medium rare beef short ribs; beef steaks; a fun baked potato story; twice-baked potatoes with bacon and cheddar cheese.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Glazed Pork and Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Honey-glazed pork shoulder; exploring the world of sheep milk cheese; the Welsh tradition of celebrating the leek; creamy potatoes and leeks.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Hearty and Light Pastas
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Sausage lasagna; canned diced tomatoes; the first industrial pasta factory in America; spaghetti with garlic and olive oil.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Grilled Lamb and Eggplant
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia grills lamb skewers, eggplant with tomato vinaigrette, tzatziki, couscous with herbs and a fruit salad.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cozy Wintertime Brunch
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Egg roulade; roasted potatoes; rosemary olive biscuits; spicy tomato jam.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Grill Roasted Chicken for Dinner
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Chicken on the grill; black-eyed pea salad with peaches; white wine sangria; nectarine and blackberry galette.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: The Grill Next Door - Greek-Inspired Girls Night
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: It's a Greek-inspired girls' night with chicken souvlaki, grilled carrots, and smoky eggplant dip.

cookingchannel.us.title: Roadtrip With G. Garvin - Houston
cookingchannel.us.description: G heads to Houston for a reminder of what a true Texan barbecue is; first stop is Tin Roof, a family-friendly spot with live entertainment and a father and son team working the smokers.

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Eatin' OK in the OKC

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Rockin' Deals in Memphis
cookingchannel.us.description: A protein waffle loaded with house-smoked pork, sausage and caramelized onions; a gourmet cafeteria for a turkey, chicken and duck sandwich; the trifecta of ooey-gooey butter cookies; a spicy and sweet coconut Panang curry.

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Chowin' Down in Cleveland
cookingchannel.us.description: Ali Khan finds the best food deals in Cleveland, including flapjacks topped with white chocolate mole and meat-stuffed cabbage rolls.

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Mountain Feast
cookingchannel.us.description: Ali visits Jackson Hole, Wyoming, for a delicious morning croque madame with mornay sauce; Ali enjoys a crunchy fried chicken banh mi sandwich and a berry cheesecake doughnut before sampling a hearty bowl of spicy pork rice.

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Crossroad Foodie
cookingchannel.us.description: Ali visits Salt Lake City and begins with a zesty pound cake-inspired French toast; he fills up on a burger topped with fried guacamole; he then visits a biker bar that serves fried Mormon funeral potatoes and ends his day with a smoky chicken club.

cookingchannel.us.title: Cheap Eats - Far From the Farm
cookingchannel.us.description: Ali starts his day in Des Moines with crisp and cheesy breakfast nachos, then has a roasted chicken lunch with mashed potatoes and onion rings before snacking on a Napoleon and finishes with a dinner of seafood stew.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Go Nuts for Donuts

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Royals and the Red River City
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah visits the Royal Winter Fair in Toronto, Canada, to sample The Blue Balsamic and The Mean Green; Noah visits the State Fair of Louisiana and tries Lupita's Gorditas, The Five Pounder burger and Not Yo Average Nachos.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Munchies on the Go
cookingchannel.us.description: The fairground wasn't made for forks and knives, so Noah Cappe is checking out the fork-free favorites and the hand-held carnival treats that keep people coming back.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Attack of the Mac and Cheese
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah Cappe arrives at the Kentucky State Fair; the Mac Ball Burger, featuring deep-fried homemade mac and cheese; the Fried Green Frank, the Derby Pie Pop and the Southern Slaw Sammie; the Mac Attack Taco; Sunday Dinner Pizza; Grilled S'more Melt.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - The Hunt for Breaded Oktoberfest
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah Cappe takes off to the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta, where the flavors are just as sky-high as the balloons.

cookingchannel.us.title: Carnival Eats - Parmageddon
cookingchannel.us.description: Noah Cappe's taste buds are brought to life at the Día de los Muertos Festival in San Antonio, Texas, where fair food staples are twisted into new fusions; he visits the Florida State Fair and the Brevard Renaissance Fair for sweet and savory treats. hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Deadly Matrimony

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Saving Face

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Fashion Police

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Church Dis-service
hln.us.description: A woman heads home after church, but never makes it there alive, triggering a homicide investigation. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-04-03

hln.us.description: Volunteers and police spend weeks searching for a missing girl. A psychic later leads them to a field where the body was found. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-04-17

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - DNA Dragnet
hln.us.description: Forensic investigators try to stop a killer who is apparently responsible for two slayings in a community in South Carolina. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-05-15

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Smiley Face
hln.us.description: When DNA proves that a man who practically admits to a brutal attack is innocent, police wonder why he is willing to take the blame. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-05-22

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Dirty Laundry
hln.us.description: When a businessman is murdered, motives and suspects are plentiful. Was it simply a disgruntled employee or client? Or do some racy photos hold the clue to the crime? (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-06-05

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Drowning Sorrows
hln.us.description: A family break turns into a nightmare when the wife is found face-down in a lake; with no idea whether it was murder, an accident or suicide, police turn to a new forensic technique. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-06-12

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - As Fault
hln.us.description: When friends see a woman in the back of a car flailing her arms and screaming, they assume she is having fun, but when they later come upon a jacket and a pool of blood, they realize they witnessed an abduction in progress. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-06-19

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Family Ties
hln.us.description: An attack on a couple's home leaves the husband dead, the wife gravely injured and their son as a prime suspect; hundreds of miles away, a DNA sample may lead to the killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-07-17

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Trouble Brewing
hln.us.description: Detectives think they've solved a murder when they find the weapon and victim's blood in a man's flat, but the evidence may have been planted. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-07-24

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Holy Terror
hln.us.description: Detectives search for the bombers of two churches in Illinois, hoping that the materials used in the remnants of the handmade bombs will offer the clues to catch the culprits. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-08-14

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Needle in a Haystack
hln.us.description: There was no apparent reason for the young, healthy college student to be dead; but when the medical examiner found the tiniest of clues during the autopsy, investigators were able to unravel the mystery of betrayal and revenge. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-08-28

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Room With a View
hln.us.description: A woman is stabbed a hundred times and her body positioned in a suggestive manner. This could be a hate crime against women. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-09-11

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Dollars and Sense
hln.us.description: Police are able to create a composite sketch of a man burnt beyond recognition. But tracking the killer is more challenging. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-09-25

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Hair Line
hln.us.description: By cutting a strand of a murdered man's hair into sections, forensics reveal a record of his last six months alive, and find he was frequently ingesting huge amounts of arsenic. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-10-02

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - All That Glitters Is Gold
hln.us.description: A bullet-riddled car, a missing driver, and no witnesses, an ambush or a random attack; the clue was something so tiny, it was measured in millionths of a meter. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-10-16

hln.us.title: Forensic Files - Deadly Rebellion
hln.us.description: Teenager is found half-naked with her throat slit; a single foreign hair found on her thumb may finger the killer. (Documentary, Crime, Medical) - 2009-10-30
