metv.us.description: A young woman from Boston encounters Marshal Matt Dillon when she journeys to meet her fiancé, an army officer.

metv.us.title: Bonanza - The Unwanted
metv.us.description: A marshal hunting an escaped convict resents his daughter's (Bonnie Bedelia) relationship with the brother of the wanted man.

metv.us.title: The Rifleman - Shotgun Man
metv.us.description: Shotgun man John Beaumont, who Lucas sent to prison, returns with vengeance on his mind.

metv.us.title: The Rifleman - Sins of the Father
metv.us.description: After shooting a man in self-defense, Andy Moon and his son turns to Lucas for protection from his vengeful brothers; they take shelter at the McCain ranch.

metv.us.title: Wagon Train - The Gabe Carswell Story
metv.us.description: An old Indian asks to join the wagon train, so his son can learn the ways of the white man because he believes the Indian way of life is dying.

metv.us.title: Emergency! - Peace Pipe
metv.us.description: The Rampart staff struggles to save a girl injured by a drunken driver; Gage's Indian heritage becomes the topic of a feud with Chet.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Fade Out, Fade In
metv.us.description: Charles Winchester joins the team; Hot Lips returns from her honeymoon; Klinger learns that his lawyer is a phony.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Fade Out, Fade In
metv.us.description: Charles Winchester is unhappy with his surroundings at the 4077th; Frank receives psychiatric treatment to get over his love affair with Hot Lips.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Fallen Idol
metv.us.description: Radar becomes depressed when he thinks that his manhood has not been fulfilled.

metv.us.title: M*A*S*H - Last Laugh
metv.us.description: B.J. receives a visit from an old college friend who proceeds to play practical jokes on the M*A*S*H members.

metv.us.title: The Andy Griffith Show - Aunt Bee's Romance
metv.us.description: Aunt Bee's former beau, Roger Hanover, pays her a visit and begins courting her again. Andy and Opie soon become annoyed at Roger's bad jokes and gags.

metvplus.us.title: Police Story - Three Days to Thirty
metvplus.us.description: A 30-year veteran (Edward Asner) risks his life on his last day to solve a final case; with Dabney Coleman.

metvplus.us.title: Police Woman - Brainwash
metvplus.us.description: A series of murders of teens leads police to a foundation using brainwashing on young runaways; guests James Olson, William Smith.

metvplus.us.title: Hunter - The Return of Whitecloud
metvplus.us.description: McCall and Hunter investigate the murder of a gallery owner involved in the illegal sale of Indian artifacts.

metvplus.us.title: T.J. Hooker - Exercise in Murder
metvplus.us.description: Stacy disappears while posing as a TV aerobics dance instructor to help crack a series of murders and thefts.

metvplus.us.title: Mod Squad - Feet of Clay
metvplus.us.description: A deaf man (Desi Arnaz Jr.) saves a guard from a warehouse fire, then retreats under the glare of publicity; guest Kevin Dobson.

metvplus.us.title: The Rookies - Vendetta
metvplus.us.description: An officer injured in a holdup returns after recovering for 10 years to hunt the man he thinks shot him; guest Lawrence Luckinbill.

metvplus.us.title: Hart to Hart - Harts on Campus
metvplus.us.description: A man who has coveted Jennifer since prep school plans to kill Jonathan during a class reunion.

metvplus.us.title: Hart to Hart - Harts at High Noon
metvplus.us.description: The Harts consider investing in a mining town turned into a tourist spot but learn not all the bullets are fake.

metvplus.us.title: Diagnosis Murder - An Explosive Murder
metvplus.us.description: After Mark is nearly killed by a bomb, Steve's protégé goes undercover to learn the terrorists' next target.

metvplus.us.title: Diagnosis Murder - Murder by the Busload
metvplus.us.description: Dr. Sloan and the others discover that a bus accident victim was actually murdered and that several of the passengers had motives to kill him.

metvplus.us.title: Fantasy Island - The Fantasy Island Girl; Saturday's Child
metvplus.us.description: A promoter's daughter (Audrey Landers) enters his beauty pageant; an actress (Stella Stevens) wants the children she gave up for adoption.

metvplus.us.title: Charlie's Angels - Angel Hunt
metvplus.us.description: A game hunter who wants Charlie for his trophy case stalks the Angels in an attempt to force their elusive employer to surface.

metvplus.us.title: Charlie's Angels - Cruising Angels
metvplus.us.description: Bosley's captaincy of Charlie's new luxury yacht is temporarily interrupted when the ship is stolen and then suddenly returned.

mgmplus.us.title: When Worlds Collide
mgmplus.us.description: After Dr. Bronson (Hayden Rorke) discovers Zyra, a new planet, fellow astronomer Dr. Hendron (Larry Keating) checks Bronson's data and reaches the horrifying conclusion that Bellus, a star in Zyra's orbit, is doomed to crash into the Earth within a matter of months. Meanwhile, Hendron's daughter, Joyce (Barbara Rush), has grown fond of pilot David Randall (Richard Derr), and pleads to have him brought along as a small group is relocated to Zyra to avoid the impending mass destruction.

mgmplus.us.title: Raging Bull
mgmplus.us.description: The story of a middleweight boxer as he rises through ranks to earn his first shot at the middleweight crown. He falls in love with a gorgeous girl from the Bronx. The inability to express his feelings enters into the ring and eventually takes over his life. He eventually is sent into a downward spiral that costs him everything.

mgmplus.us.title: Saint Maud
mgmplus.us.description: Maud, an unstable, newly devout hospice nurse, becomes obsessed with saving her dying patient's soul -- but sinister forces and her own sinful past threaten her holy calling.

mgmplus.us.title: From Beyond
mgmplus.us.description: Obsessive scientist Dr. Pretorius (Ted Sorel) successfully discovers a way to access a parallel universe of pleasure by tapping into the brain's pineal gland. When he is seemingly killed by forces from this other dimension, his assistant, Dr. Crawford Tillinghast (Jeffrey Combs), is accused of the murder. After psychiatrist Katherine McMichaels (Barbara Crampton) and detective Bubba Brownlee (Ken Foree) take the case, the trio risks a return to the other world in order to solve the mystery.

mgmplus.us.title: The Believers
mgmplus.us.description: Recently widowed psychiatrist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) has just moved back to New York City with his young son, Chris (Harley Cross), in an attempt to start over after his wife's horrific accidental death. Cal takes an assignment helping the police with the investigation of a cult-like and bizarre ritualistic double murder. As Cal gets closer to the truth, he realizes that he and those close to him may be the target of supernatural and deadly forces, and that the enemy is closer than he knows. (movie) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: The Last House on the Left
mgmplus.us.description: Teenagers Mari and Phyllis head to the city for a concert, then afterward go looking for drugs. Instead, they find a gang of escaped convicts who subject them to a night of torture and rape. The gang then kills the girls in the woods, not realizing they're near Mari's house. When they pose as salesmen and are taken in by Mari's mother and father, it doesn't take the parents long to figure out their identities and plot revenge. (movie) - 1972

mgmplus.us.title: Is God Is
mgmplus.us.description: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths. (movie) - 2026

mgmplus.us.title: Secret Service
mgmplus.us.description: MI6 agent Kate Henderson uncovers an audacious plot involving Russia and an asset in the UK Cabinet; Kate's hunt for the mole puts her agent's life at risk. (Drama, Thriller) - 2026-04-27

mgmplus.us.title: The Institute - Double Cross
mgmplus.us.description: Luke and friends adjust to their new surroundings; Sigsby sizes up Nolan as a potential rival; Tim chases his only lead in the search for an ally. (Thriller) - 2026-11-22

mgmplus.us.title: Lockbox
mgmplus.us.description: Seeking peace after her mother's death, Ellen retreats to a rural town and takes in her severely traumatized cousin, Winthrop. Their fragile domestic balance soon shatters when an erratic neighbor warns her that Winthrop is dangerous. As strange phenomena start to escalate, Ellen must put everything on the line to defend Winthrop from a dangerous, otherworldly entity that's determined to track him down. (movie) - 2026

mgmplus.us.title: Vampire Carnival
mgmplus.us.description: A mysterious carnival lures a directionless young woman from her broken home, but a secret about its troupe forces her to face her demons. (movie) - 2026

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: To Catch a Thief
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Notorious cat burglar John Robie (Cary Grant) has long since retired to tend vineyards on the French Riviera. When a series of robberies is committed in his style, John must clear his name. Armed with a list of people who own the most expensive jewels currently in the area, John begins following the first owner, young Francie (Grace Kelly). When her jewels are stolen, Francie suspects John, destroying their tentative romance. John goes on the lam to catch the thief and clear his own name.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Mouse Hunt
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: When their string magnate father, Rudolph Smuntz, dies, brothers Ernie (Nathan Lane) and Lars (Lee Evans) move into his decrepit mansion. Struggling to keep a promise to never sell the now unprofitable string factory, the brothers decide that restoring the house, the last built by a famous architect, could bring them a great deal of money. But during their restoration attempts, Ernie and Lars are continually frustrated by a malicious mouse that keeps destroying their efforts.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Rain Man
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Uninvited
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Below
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Red Eye
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Stigmata
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A young woman with no strong religious beliefs, Frankie Paige (Patricia Arquette) begins having strange and violent experiences, showing signs of the wounds that Jesus received when crucified. When the Vatican gets word of Frankie's situation, a high-ranking cardinal (Jonathan Pryce) requests that the Rev. Andrew Kiernan (Gabriel Byrne) investigate her case. Soon Kiernan realizes that very sinister forces are at work, and tries to rescue Frankie from the entity that is plaguing her.

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1998-07-24

mgmplushits.us.title: Hondo
mgmplushits.us.description: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son.

mgmplushits.us.title: Suburbicon
mgmplushits.us.description: Suburbicon is a peaceful, idyllic, suburban community with affordable homes and manicured lawns -- the perfect place to raise a family, and in the summer of 1959, the Lodge family is doing just that. But the tranquil surface masks a disturbing reality, as husband and father Gardner Lodge must navigate the town's dark underbelly of betrayal, deceit and violence.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
mgmplushits.us.description: In the Southwest during the Civil War, a mysterious stranger, Joe (Clint Eastwood), and a Mexican outlaw, Tuco (Eli Wallach), form an uneasy partnership -- Joe turns in the bandit for the reward money, then rescues him just as he is being hanged. When Joe's shot at the noose goes awry during one escapade, a furious Tuco tries to have him murdered. The men re-team abruptly, however, to beat out a sadistic criminal and the Union army and find $20,000 that a soldier has buried in the desert.

mgmplushits.us.title: The Dictator
mgmplushits.us.description: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule. (movie) - 2012

mgmplushits.us.title: Kingpin
mgmplushits.us.description: Roy Munson (Woody Harrelson) is a young bowler with a promising career ahead of him until a disreputable colleague, Ernie McCracken (Bill Murray), tricks him into participating in a con game that ends with Roy's bowling hand crippled for life. Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). With the help of a gangster's girlfriend (Vanessa Angel), he plots to take Ishmael to the top of the bowling world. (movie) - 1996

mgmplushits.us.title: The Stepford Wives
mgmplushits.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (movie) - 2004

mgmplushits.us.title: Bulletproof Monk
mgmplushits.us.description: For 60 years, a mysterious monk with no name has zigzagged the globe to protect an ancient scroll -- a scroll that holds the key to unlimited power. Now the Monk must look for a new scroll keeper. Kar is an unlikely candidate, a streetwise young man whose only interest is himself. But when he inadvertently saves the Bulletproof Monk from capture, the two become partners in a scheme to save the world from the scroll's most avid pursuer. (movie) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Home for the Holidays
mgmplushits.us.description: When her teenage daughter opts out of Thanksgiving, single mother Claudia Larson (Holly Hunter) travels alone to her childhood home for an explosive holiday dinner with her dysfunctional family. Claudia quickly tires of her parents, her long-suffering sister (Cynthia Stevenson), her snobby brother-in-law (Steve Guttenberg) and her nutty aunt (Geraldine Chaplin). But the evening gets interesting when sparks fly between Claudia and her brother's handsome friend Leo Fish (Dylan McDermott). (movie) - 1995

mgmplushits.us.title: Fargo
mgmplushits.us.description: "Fargo" is a reality-based crime drama set in Minnesota in 1987. Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) is a car salesman in Minneapolis who has gotten himself into debt and is so desperate for money that he hires two thugs (Steve Buscemi), (Peter Stormare) to kidnap his own wife. Jerry will collect the ransom from her wealthy father (Harve Presnell), paying the thugs a small portion and keeping the rest to satisfy his debts. The scheme collapses when the thugs shoot a state trooper. (movie) - 1996

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Henry V
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In this gritty screen adaptation of Shakespeare's play about the heroic and ruthless king, Henry V of England (Kenneth Branagh) determines to lay claim to the kingdom of France. Henry's self-doubt and the diminished morale of his army stand in the way of a victory that would unite the two countries and provide Henry with a queen (Emma Thompson). However, his sheer determination and his impassioned speeches ready his men for the bloodiest of battles -- Agincourt.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Men at Work
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Carl Taylor (Charlie Sheen) and James St. James (Emilio Estevez) are garbage men who spend their workdays goofing around and disrupting the quiet on the streets of their town. But their good-natured fun comes to an abrupt halt when they discover a local politician's corpse in one of their cans. Determined that this is their chance to be more than trash collectors, this snarky pair of amateur detectives decide to solve the case on their own and so become entangled in a toxic waste cover-up.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Harlem Nights
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy).

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Con artist Lawrence Jamieson (Michael Caine) is a longtime resident of a luxurious coastal resort, where he enjoys the fruits of his deceptions -- that is, until a competitor, Freddy Benson (Steve Martin), shows up. When the new guy's lowbrow tactics impinge on his own work, Jamieson resolves to get rid of him. Confident of his own duplicitous talents, Jamieson challenges Benson to a winner-takes-all competition: whoever swindles their latest mark first can stay, while the other must leave town.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Bandits
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Joe (Bruce Willis) and Terry (Billy Bob Thornton) have escaped from prison. Cutting a swath from Oregon through California, these fugitives rob banks in order to finance their scheme for a new -- and somewhat legitimate -- life south of the border. Unfortunately, things get more complicated when they meet Kate Wheeler (Cate Blanchett), who runs into Terry with her car. Kate joins the bandits on their cross-country spree, and eventually she steals something, too: their hearts.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Worldbreaker
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Annihilation
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Lena, a biologist and former soldier, joins a mission to uncover what happened to her husband inside Area X -- a sinister and mysterious phenomenon that is expanding across the American coastline. Once inside, the expedition discovers a world of mutated landscapes and creatures, as dangerous as it is beautiful, that threatens both their lives and their sanity.

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Running Man
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the near future, "The Running Man" is the top-rated show on television, a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards is convinced by the show's ruthless producer to enter the game as a last resort. Ratings soon skyrocket as Ben's defiance, instincts and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite, as well as a threat to the entire system.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish 3
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Mechanic
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Mr. Majestyk
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Over The Top
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Walking Tall: The Payback
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Hercules (2014)
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Red Dawn
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Donovan's Brain
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Return Of Count Yorga
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Blacula
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The eternally cool William Marshall puts a fresh spin on the age-old legend of the vampire, condemned to wander the Earth with an insatiable lust for blood in "Blacula," often credited as the first African American horror film.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Scream, Blacula, Scream!
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Brought back to the world of the living by a voodoo ceremony Blacula (William Marshall) is loosed with insatiable bloodlust upon the population of a small community in the Louisiana back country. Pam Grier also stars in this scintillating sequel.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Sugar Hill
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a nightclub entrepreneur gets taken out by the mob, his girlfriend calls upon a voodoo high priest to carry out an unholy plan for revenge.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Audrey Rose
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Believers
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Spikes Gang
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Three Old West farm boys help a wounded bank robber (Lee Marvin), and he teaches them the trade.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A scout (Lee Marvin) and his Indian sidekick (Oliver Reed) find their ex-partner (Robert Culp) spending their loot in 1908 Colorado.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Alias Jesse James
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Three Amigos!
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Three silent-film cowboys (Chevy Chase, Steve Martin, Martin Short) come to Mexico to perform but instead are expected to save a town.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: From Noon Till Three
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A frontier widow (Jill Ireland) makes a pulp-novel legend out of her three-hour affair with a third-rate outlaw (Charles Bronson).

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Horse Soldiers
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Red River
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) fights with his foster son (Montgomery Clift) on the first cattle drive up the Chisholm Trail.

militaryhistory.us.title: Tired of Aging? Super Pill's Secret to Lasting Youth & Vitality!
militaryhistory.us.description: Tired of feeling old? Discover The Super Pill! 6 elite formulas packed with clinically studied ingredients for revolutionary heart, brain, joint, immune, skin, and eye health. Don't just age-thrive! Unlock your ultimate vitality and well-being today.

militaryhistory.us.title: Tales of the Gun - German Small Arms of World War II
militaryhistory.us.description: The feared and often respected weapons of the German army from 1939 to 1945, including the Schmeisser, Luger, Mauser and Karabiner K98k.

militaryhistory.us.title: Tales of the Gun - U.S. Guns of World War II
militaryhistory.us.description: The weapons of World War II included instruments that pierced the dark and others that released the power of the atom.

militaryhistory.us.title: Mail Call - Re-Fueling a Fighter Jet; Naval Signal Flags; GI Chow
militaryhistory.us.description: How to refuel a fighter jet in midair; how ships send messages using signal flags; what soldiers eat.

militaryhistory.us.title: Mail Call - Revolutionary War Musket; Jousting; Foxholes

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible
movies.us.description: When U.S. government operative Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his mentor, Jim Phelps (Jon Voight), go on a covert assignment that takes a disastrous turn, Jim is killed, and Ethan becomes the prime murder suspect. Now a fugitive, Hunt recruits brilliant hacker Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) and maverick pilot Franz Krieger (Jean Reno) to help him sneak into a heavily guarded CIA building to retrieve a confidential computer file that will prove his innocence.

movies.us.title: Mission: Impossible 2
movies.us.description: Tom Cruise returns to his role as Ethan Hunt in the second installment of "Mission: Impossible." This time Ethan Hunt leads his IMF team on a mission to capture a deadly German virus before it is released by terrorists. His mission is made impossible due to the fact that he is not the only person after samples of the disease. He must also contest with a gang of international terrorists headed by a turned bad former IMF agent who has already managed to steal the cure.

moviesphere.us.title: I Can Do Bad All by Myself
moviesphere.us.description: Madea catches teenage Jennifer and her two younger brothers looting her home. She decides to take matters into her own hands and delivers the young delinquents to the only relative they have, their aunt April, who wants nothing to do with the kids.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Meet the Browns
moviesphere.us.description: Single mother Brenda (Angela Bassett) suddenly loses her job, then she receives news that the father she never met is dead. With nothing to lose, she gathers her brood and heads to Georgia, where she meets her father's uproarious family for the first time and finds the tentative beginnings of a new romance.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
moviesphere.us.description: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

moviesphere.us.title: Tyler Perry's the Family That Preys
moviesphere.us.description: Despite their differences in social class, Charlotte (Kathy Bates) and Alice (Alfre Woodard) are good friends for many years. Then secrets, greed and scandal surrounding both their families throw the women's lives into turmoil. Charlotte and Alice set out on a road trip across the country, hoping to gain perspective and save the situation from ruin.

moviesphere.us.title: The Single Moms Club
moviesphere.us.description: When their children face expulsion because of rule infractions, five single mothers must agree to organize the school's upcoming dance and fundraiser. Although they range from alpha professional to fast-food worker, the women find they have one thing in common: a need for support and an understanding ear. They form the Single Moms Club to help ease one another's burdens and reclaim their freedom. As their stress begins to lessen, the women find that finding love may be possible again.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Historias de la Virgen morena - Necesito a mi madre
nbcuniverso.us.description: Elisa está agobiada con la maternidad y descuida a su madre, que se pierde. Elisa se siente culpable de la situación y descubre cuánto necesita a su mamá.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Dolores, sin pecado concebida
nbcuniverso.us.description: No poder consumar su matrimonio es un tormento para Dolores, ella desea ayuda profesional, pero los prejuicios religiosos lo impiden. Demostrar que fue víctima de una doble moral la hace libre.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Martina, quisiera ser yo quien esté enferma
nbcuniverso.us.description: El hecho de que su hermana sea la prioridad de sus padres resiente a Martina. Sabe que ignorar lo que pasa y tener secretos no resolverá las cosas. Por su familia, usa el dolor para crear arte.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Lo que callamos las mujeres - Rosa: Una guerrera invencible
nbcuniverso.us.description: Rosa es una exitosa influencer que acaba de comprometer y al sentirse cansada, acude al médico y sus estudios determinan que tiene cáncer de mama.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Un día para vivir - La dealer
nbcuniverso.us.description: Griselda haría cualquier cosa por amor a su esposo, a su hijo y a sí misma. Traiciona, miente y entra en negocios turbios, sin saber que el amor puede fallar y ella debe escoger un nuevo rumbo.

nbcuniverso.us.title: Acércate a Rocío
nbcuniverso.us.description: Hablar de los problemas es el primer paso para superarlos y, por eso, Rocío trae un programa único para hablar de las preocupaciones de cada día y, en conjunto, encontrar una solución.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - The Bleed Valve
network.us.description: Atwater's worlds collide when a shooting at the building he owns in Burnside leaves a child dead; Atwater must confront his relationship with his father, Lew, as the brutal case forces them together.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Fight
network.us.description: Upton is unwittingly drawn into a deadly betrayal and finds herself in a fight for her life; with minimal leads, Voight and the team scramble to find her before it's too late.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - New Life
network.us.description: Torres finds himself in the midst of a murder case that hits close to home and threatens to expose his troubled past; as he struggles to reconcile his old life with his new one, Voight keeps a watchful eye.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - A Better Place
network.us.description: As Richard Beck's timeline for a deadly attack moves up and Samantha panics, Ruzek and the team scramble to get ahead of unprecedented disaster.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Retread
network.us.description: Ruzek gets mixed up in a case after a late-night poker game is raided; afraid of becoming like his father, Ruzek struggles to stand down and allow Intelligence to carry out the investigation while he remains on leave.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Safe Harbor
network.us.description: Burgess works an extra shift at the 13th District and gets caught in the middle of a drive-by attack on refugees; the team works together to track down the shooter and uncover the true motive behind the attack.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Escape
network.us.description: Returning from furlough, Torres goes undercover in a tense and high-stakes drug trafficking case.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Split Second
network.us.description: Atwater turns to an unlikely source of support when a string of jewelry store robberies shakes his confidence.

network.us.title: Chicago P.D. - Survival
network.us.description: Intelligence teams up with ASA Chapman to take on an abduction case involving a teenager; the case hits close to home for Voight, leading him to take a personal interest in finding justice for the victim.

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Pay It Forward
network.us.description: A series of freeway car accidents leads to a catastrophic overpass collapse that endangers the lives of civilians and members of the 118.

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Abandon Ships
network.us.description: Athena and Bobby set off on their honeymoon cruise, but when duty calls, their vacation is put on hold; a fighter jet traps a civilian; an unusual incident leaves a couple stuck together.

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Rock the Boat
network.us.description: The disastrous cruise continues when Bobby and Athena respond to the ship's explosion, racing to aid injured passengers; Hen questions her instincts in a life-taking call and grows concerned about Athena and Bobby's whereabouts.

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Capsized
network.us.description: With each moment becoming critical as the ship flips upside down, Athena and Bobby take charge, seeking methods for rescue while navigating efforts to guide survivors to safety; Hen defies protocols in her search for Bobby and Athena.

network.us.title: 9-1-1 - Mother's Boy ᴺᵉʷ
network.us.description: Eddie and Buck's flight back to Los Angeles is cancelled following the National Firefighter Games; hoping to be home for Hen's birthday, Eddie and Buck decide a cross-country road trip is the fastest way, until Buck goes missing.

outermax.us.description: Bamboo-home architect David Sands seizes the opportunity to build his own getaway in Hawaii that features a luxurious outdoor bath area and detached, starlit master bedroom; however, volcanic eruptions threaten to send the entire project up in smoke.

outlaw.us.title: Canyon River
outlaw.us.description: A rancher's (George Montgomery) foreman (Peter Graves) schemes against him on a cattle drive from Oregon to Wyoming.

outlaw.us.title: Allegheny Uprising
outlaw.us.description: In Colonial America, Jim Smith (John Wayne) leads a group, including the intense Janie MacDougall (Claire Trevor), that tries to figure out who is supplying the area Native American tribes with weapons. He suspects corrupt trader Ralph Callendar (Brian Donlevy), but does not have proof yet. Jim's accusations fall on deaf ears with unsympathetic British commander Capt. Swanson (George Sanders). Worse, Callendar, sensing that Jim is on to him, frames the hero for murder.

outlaw.us.title: Wichita
outlaw.us.description: After a group of drunken trail riders runs amok, Mayor Andrew Hope (Carl Benton Reid) of Wichita, Kan., recruits the intrepid Wyatt Earp (Joel McCrea) to end lawlessness. Armed and ready for anything, the new marshal decides he will end gun violence simply by banning guns. Soon Earp must face crooked rancher Clint Wallace (Walter Sande) and whiskey slinger Doc Black (Edgar Buchanan), vicious locals who like Wichita exactly as it is and don't take kindly to being told what to do.

outlaw.us.title: Man in the Wilderness
outlaw.us.description: When an expedition of early 1800s fur trappers in the American Northwest encounters a bear while hunting, their scout, Zach (Richard Harris), is unfortunately mauled. Although Zach's wounds are treated by the medic, the leader of the troop, Henry (John Huston), believes he will die and orders the troop to continue on while Zach is left behind. But Henry has underestimated Zach's will to live -- he survives and manages to regain his strength, in order to track the troop and exact revenge.

outlaw.us.title: Stranger on Horseback
outlaw.us.description: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

outlaw.us.title: Four for Texas
outlaw.us.description: In the 1870s, two rival businessmen, Zack Thomas (Frank Sinatra) and Joe Jarrett (Dean Martin), on a stagecoach heading to Galveston, Texas, must pull together to protect $100,000 from an outlaw named Matson (Charles Bronson). Once in Galveston, however, their rivalry continues, as Thomas joins up with Elya Carlson (Anita Ekberg) and Jarrett with Maxine Richter (Ursula Andress). But Matson is still on the loose, and a scheming banker threatens both Thomas and Jarrett.

outlaw.us.title: Miracle in the Wilderness
outlaw.us.description: A 1850s couple (Kris Kristofferson, Kim Cattrall) and their baby are kidnapped at Christmas by a Blackfeet chief (Sheldon Peters Wolfchild) avenging his son.

outlaw.us.title: 3 Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: Thieves and rustlers Robert Hightower (John Wayne), Pete Fuerte (Pedro Armendáriz) and the Abilene Kid (Harry Carey Jr.) rob a bank in a small Arizona town. Pursued across the desert by the indefatigable Sheriff Buck Sweet (Ward Bond), the trio lose their horses, suffer injuries, and come across a stranded woman (Mildred Natwick) who is dying while giving birth. Promising to carry the woman's newborn to safety, the repentant criminals struggle to reach the village of New Jerusalem.

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

paranormalfiles.us.title: The Conspiracy Show
paranormalfiles.us.description: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy.

paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

sbsbrisbane.au.title: SBS World News Late - Sbs World News Late 2026 Ep 223 ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: The Corsican Line - Episode 2
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Following a mayor's murder, tensions rise as rival interests compete for control of Corsica's lucrative waste management industry. Reda reconnects with former associates while trying to navigate a dangerous criminal landscape. Meanwhile, Judge Ines pursues her investigation, uncovering links between powerful families, organised crime networks and a business empire with far-reaching influence.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 1
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A frozen body is found on the boundary stone right on the Austro-German border, as if propped up for some pagan ritual. Shortly after the disparate investigation duo, police inspector Gedeon Winter from Austria and commissioner Ellie Stocker from Germany, have joined up on the case, the killer sends audio messages to the press.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 2
sbsbrisbane.au.description: A German entrepreneur has been killed in Austria. His secret lover was found comatose on a ski piste late at night, drenched in blood. Evidence links this case to the first murder. Ellie, the optimistic and confident investigator from Bavarian Berchtesgaden and her Austrian counterpart Gedeon, the nihilistic cynic from Salzburg, realise they are dealing with a highly intelligent and cold-blooded killer.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 3
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Tipped off by the killer’s horrific photo fit, the investigators unearth the Krampus legend - a symbolic creature infamous for punishing the naughty and unworthy. This leads them to Sebastian Brunner, head of a rural sect, whose books on the end of civilisation seem to have inspired the killer.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Pagan Peak - Pagan Peak Series 1 Ep 4
sbsbrisbane.au.description: In a joint effort with cultist Brunner, Ellie and Gedeon try to set a trap for the killer. For this plan to work, they have to overstep legal boundaries. Trying to gain the trust of the killer, they feign a copycat murder, hoping their target would be lured into reaching out to Brunner.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: James May: Our Man In Italy - God's Apology
sbsbrisbane.au.description: James' journey begins with him exploring Sicily, an island where cultures collide under the shadow of Mount Etna. James explores the simple pleasures that have sustained people for generations.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize - Li Hongzhang's Chop Suey
sbsbrisbane.au.description: All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Nhk World English News Morning
sbsbrisbane.au.description: English news from Japan's Broadcasting Corporation, NHK, delivering the latest in business, technology, health, environmental and world news.

sbsbrisbane.au.title: Anc Philippines The World Tonight
sbsbrisbane.au.description: Multi-award winning newscast on ABS-CBN and ANC, The World Tonight delivers the top stories of the day, covering political, economic, and social sectors on both local and global fronts.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E29 Kangaroo Island Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S3 E18 Sneak Attack Give yourself a nutritional sneak attack with Mary's recipes that cram in the good stuff without skimping on flavour.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Diana Chan's Malaysia
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Heritage Heritage visits Rumah Putih, experiences Rumah Makan Rendang Tok Yeop and cooks Pucuk Paku Masak Cili Api and Dendeng Daging.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Nigella Express
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E12 Razzle Dazzle It's party time at Nigella's and this is one party that's full of fast, easy, delicious make in advance recipes and simple, achievable, last minute touches to make the food table and the party itself.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E2 Piedmont Stanley Tucci visits the region that made the dream of unified Italy a reality. Piedmont boasts refined French heritage of the Middle Ages, and is now spearheading a slow food revolution.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Ishikawa In his wife's hometown, Adam Liaw uncovers the secrets to superb sake, samples some of the world's best sushi and prepares a classic Japanese dish with his mother-in-law.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S1 E5 Curried Fish Pie, Butter And Sage Gnudi And Hummingbird Cake Episode five sees Jamie and young son, Buddy, making a curried fish pie. Unlike a traditional fish pie, this Indian-inspired version has amazing perfumed layers of flavour and a crispy top.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Poh & Co. Bitesize
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S2 E3 Episode 3 The delicious world of acclaimed cook, artist and lover of life Poh Ling Yeow, with a guide to some of her favourite dishes.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S6 E13 Food Culture Jung Eun Chae from Chae restaurant and Ukrainian chef Ivegen Klopotenko are in the kitchen with Adam, cooking with fermented ingredients.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S5 E3 Venison In this episode of Wild Game Kitchen, Andrew Zimmern demonstrates two distinct approaches to cooking venison.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
sbsfoodmelbourne.au.description: S9 E12 One Dish, Two Meals Weeknight dinners just got easier by Lidia simply serving one recipe two ways! Lidia prepares a zucchini, peas, and pancetta risotto, risotto cakes, and talks about capellini asparagus frittatas.

sbsfoodmelbourne.au.title: Cheese Slices

screamboxtv.us.description: A circus' morbid sideshow attraction leaves an indelible impression on a young boy's mind.

screamboxtv.us.title: The Grave
screamboxtv.us.description: The quest for buried treasure leads two escaped convicts (Craig Sheffer, Josh Charles) to old friends, an ex-flame (Gabrielle Anwar) and one's shooting.

screenpix.us.title: Article 99
screenpix.us.description: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous Article 99, a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

screenpix.us.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
screenpix.us.description: A rebel leader educates a Dominican Republic woman (Salma Hayek) about the abuses of a corrupt dictator (Edward James Olmos).

screenpix.us.title: Park Row
screenpix.us.description: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

screenpix.us.title: The Square Peg
screenpix.us.description: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

screenpix.us.title: Albino Alligator
screenpix.us.description: When a robbery in New Orleans ends in disaster, the mercurial burglar Dova escapes with his cohorts to a seedy, nearby bar. Capturing all those inside, the criminals trade barbs with the establishment's feisty bartender Janet Boudreaux. The pub becomes highly volatile, however, when the police encircle it; as it turns out, they were already there surveilling another of the bar's patrons, a suspected illicit arms trafficker named Guy Foucard. (movie) - 1996

screenpix.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpix.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. (movie) - 1996

screenpix.us.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
screenpix.us.description: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr). (movie) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: War, Italian Style
screenpix.us.description: Two Marines (Fred Clark) fool a German general (Buster Keaton) with documents and disguises in World War II Italy. (movie) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: Romance and Cigarettes
screenpix.us.description: In this musical that features characters lip-synching to classic songs, Nick (James Gandolfini), a Queens, N.Y.-based ironworker, lives with his wife, Kitty (Susan Sarandon), and three daughters. When Nick meets a significantly younger woman, Tula (Kate Winslet), he starts an affair with her, much to the chagrin of his wife, and his life is thrown into upheaval. Kitty kicks Nick out of the house, and he is forced to make some difficult decisions. (movie) - 2005

screenpix.us.title: Billie
screenpix.us.description: Billie (Patty Duke) is a tomboy who loves sports. When the high school track coach (Charles Lane) sees her run, he asks her to join the school team. Her inclusion in the formerly all-male team causes quite a stir, especially with her father (Jim Backus). He is typically supportive of Billie, but now he worries that her shocking behavior will cost him his bid for mayor. Nervously, he starts setting Billie up with dates, unaware that she has a crush on her classmate, Mike (Warren Berlinger). (movie) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: The First Time
screenpix.us.description: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them. (movie) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Neanderthal Man
screenpixaction.us.description: A scientist (Robert Shayne) turns his maid into an ape-woman, his cat into a tiger and himself into an ape-man.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Screaming Skull
screenpixaction.us.description: A man (John Hudson) tries to drive his second wife (Peggy Webber) mad at his dead first wife's Southern mansion.

screenpixaction.us.title: Portrait in Terror
screenpixaction.us.description: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

screenpixaction.us.title: Incident in an Alley
screenpixaction.us.description: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpixaction.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

screenpixaction.us.title: The Man in the Net
screenpixaction.us.description: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him. (movie) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Lady of Vengeance
screenpixaction.us.description: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead. (movie) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Four Boys and a Gun
screenpixaction.us.description: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup. (movie) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Warriors of Virtue
screenpixaction.us.description: Lame in one leg, Ryan Jeffers has few friends in his high school and spends most of his time with Chinese restaurant chef Ming, who gives him the Book of Tao. When he is goaded by the football team into a dangerous ceremony, Ryan falls into a whirlpool and emerges in the magical land of Tao. His leg fully healed, he is led to Master Chung, whose heroic warriors battle against greedy Lord Komodo. Ryan joins their fight. (movie) - 1997

screenpixaction.us.title: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
screenpixaction.us.description: Round Table knight Gawain (Murray Head) beheads the Green Knight (Nigel Green), who expects a return stroke. (movie) - 1973

screenpixaction.us.title: The Boy and the Pirates
screenpixaction.us.description: On the beach near his home, Jimmy (Charles Herbert) finds a bottle that contains a genie named Abu (Joseph Turkel), who magically transports him to the ship of the pirate Blackbeard (Murvyn Vye). Abu explains that the bottle must be returned to its original location in three days, or Jimmy will take the genie's place. The pair spend a few eventful days with Blackbeard, evading capture, accompanied by a girl (Susan Gordon) they rescue, but Jimmy begins to wonder if he'll ever get back home. (movie) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
screenpixaction.us.description: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun. (movie) - 1969

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mercenary Fighters
screenpixvoices.us.description: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Windprints
screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

screenpixvoices.us.title: For Us, the Living
screenpixvoices.us.description: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mandela
screenpixvoices.us.description: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

screenpixvoices.us.title: Getting Even
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets. (movie) - 1986

screenpixvoices.us.title: Mercenary Fighters
screenpixvoices.us.description: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project. (movie) - 1988

screenpixvoices.us.description: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. screenpixvoices.us.title: Gabriela
screenpixvoices.us.description: A rich Turkish bar owner (Sônia Braga) falls in love with his beautiful Brazilian cook (Marcello Mastroianni). (movie) - 1983

screenpixvoices.us.title: Go Fish
screenpixvoices.us.description: After leaving behind her girlfriend to attend college in Chicago, young lesbian Max West (Guinevere Turner) is introduced to Ely (V.S. Brodie), a slightly older woman with quirky habits. While Max and Ely quickly develop an attraction to each other, a poorly timed phone call from Max's long-distance girlfriend, Kate, brings things to an abrupt halt. Meanwhile, Max's roommate, Kia (T. Wendy McMillan), helps her girlfriend, Evy (Migdalia Melendez), cope with some tough times at home. (movie) - 1994

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Perez Family
screenpixvoices.us.description: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades. (movie) - 1995

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Revenge
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Jonas Bell is killed in a scuffle with Hollister after a bank clerk is murdered; siblings Noah and Lady Bell conspire to avenge their father targeting Hollister.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Alamo: Thirteen Days to Glory
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In 1836, Jim Bowie, Davy Crockett and the Texas rebels make a heroic last stand at the Alamo against the Mexican army of several thousand men led by General Santa Anna.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blood Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the 1890s California, Sicilian winemakers battle with a railroad tycoon over control of the land. William Berrigan will stop at nothing to get what he wants -- a train track running through the valley. Standing in his way is the Collogero family: father Sebastian, son Marco, and daughter Maria. But Berrigan makes a misjudgment when he orders the death of Sebastian, which launches a blood war in the vine-strangled hills.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Rebel in Town
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bedloe Mason and his four sons ride into an Arizona outpost after robbing a bank. When they hear a gun go off behind them, one son immediately turns around and shoots to kill. But his victim turns out to be a young boy with a toy gun, so the Masons hightail it out of town, save for Bedloe's son Gray, who feels guilty and stays to see the kid buried. Yet Gray's presence only stirs up more trouble as the child's father, John, looks for violent revenge.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Valdez Is Coming
screenpixwesterns.us.description: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle. (movie) - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Halliday Brand
screenpixwesterns.us.description: As his father, Big Dan (Ward Bond), lies dying, estranged son Daniel Halliday (Joseph Cotten) returns to the family cattle ranch and recalls why he left home. Years before, Big Dan discovered that his daughter, Martha (Betsy Blair), was in love with Native American ranch hand Jivaro (Christopher Dark) and had the young man arrested on false charges. Outraged, Daniel left home and teamed with Jivaro's beautiful sister (Viveca Lindfors) and vengeful father (Jay C. Flippen) for retribution. (movie) - 1957

screenpixwesterns.us.title: More Dead Than Alive
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An outlaw responsible for many deaths, Cain is released from prison after years behind bars. Despite his earlier wicked ways, Cain has made a real effort to reform and just wants to be left in peace. Unfortunately, his reputation limits his employment options, and he's left with no choice except becoming a performer in a Wild West show. Working for promoter Dan Ruffalo, Cain attempts to lead a relatively quiet life, but other gunslingers are still out to get him. (movie) - 1969

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Promised Land
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A town full of former outlaws kidnaps Bat and expects him to work as their trusty banker. (Western) - 1959-06-10

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Conspiracy
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat finds himself involved in the Lincoln assassination conspiracy 15 years after the crime. (Western) - 1959-06-17

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Hostage
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Murderer Sam Edwards has been sentenced to hang, but his brother, John, kidnaps Harris and takes him hostage to save Sam from the gallows. (Western) - 1960-04-08

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - The Governor
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister risks his life to rescue the governor, who has been kidnapped by a gang. (Western) - 1960-04-16

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Wanda Nevada
screenpixwesterns.us.description: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks. (movie) - 1979

screenpixwesterns.us.title: A Dog's Best Friend
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd. (movie) - 1960

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Belle of the Yukon
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A con man who has tried to turn over a new leaf, Honest John Calhoun (Randolph Scott) is the owner and operator of a dance hall in the north of Canada. John has hoped to evade both the police and his past, but his history catches up with him when his ex-girlfriend, Belle De Valle (Gypsy Rose Lee), appears in his venue as a member of a dance troupe. As John and Belle reunite, fellow entertainer Lettie Candless (Dinah Shore) also becomes infatuated with the suave businessman. (movie) - 1944

secnetwork.us.description: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is "SEC Now," broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, Peter Burns or Alyssa Lang, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - Vanderbilt at Florida
secnetwork.us.description: The Vanderbilt Commodores (4-6, 1-6 SEC) visit the No. 24 Florida Gators (6-4, 4-4). Vanderbilt enters this game after falling 21-6 to Alabama and relies on Jared Curtis on offense. Florida beat Kentucky 21-14 last week behind Aaron Philo.

secnetwork.us.title: College Football - Texas A&M at Oklahoma
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 22 Oklahoma Sooners (6-4, 4-3 SEC) face the Texas A&M Aggies (4-6, 1-6) at Memorial Stadium. Oklahoma beat Ole Miss 24-17 and seeks to make it three straight wins, while Texas A&M seeks to snap a three-game skid behind Marcel Reed.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network.

secnetwork.us.title: Women's College Basketball - Southeastern Louisiana at Texas ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: The No. 6 Texas Longhorns clash with the Southeastern Louisiana Lady Lions in regular NCAA play. Texas looks to protect home court after beating Ohio State 75-61, while Southeastern Louisiana aims to rebound from a 74-68 defeat against Louisiana.

secnetwork.us.description: From Vaught-Hemingway Stadium in Oxford, Miss.

shadesofblack.us.title: Eve of Destruction
shadesofblack.us.description: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

shadesofblack.us.title: The Last Letter
shadesofblack.us.description: Catherine Wright struggles with a debilitating sleep disorder. Her husband Michael struggles to cope when their newborn son lies awake.

shadesofblack.us.title: Original Gangstas
shadesofblack.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

shadesofblack.us.title: School Dance
shadesofblack.us.description: A teen (Bobb'e J. Thompson) hopes to impress a girl he likes by winning a spot on his school's hottest dance crew.
